title: LA to Phoenix
summary: I-10 from the East LA interchange to Buckeye. Blythe has DC fast charging: EVCS at US Bank lists CCS and CHAdeMO, and DOE's port count does not match that page. Ehrenberg's Tesla sites were checked on Tesla's locator.
startNote: Mileage starts at I-10 exit 16B, the west end of the East Los Angeles Interchange (mile 16.23), and ends at Watson Road in Buckeye (Arizona mile 117.01). California to the state line is 243.31 − 16.23 = 227.08 miles, plus 117.01 in Arizona, which is 344.09 and shown as 344.

stops.name: Blythe
stops.milepostNote: 7th Street is exit 240, mile 239.98. 239.98 − 16.23 = 223.8. Hobson Way is exits 242 and 243.

tips.text: Blythe has DC fast charging. EVCS lists 2 CCS and 2 CHAdeMO connectors, up to 50 kW, at 100 Hobsonway. DOE lists 2 DC ports at that address. Both numbers are on the stop. ChargePoint sites on Donlon Street were not confirmed on ChargePoint's locator. Ehrenberg's Tesla sites were checked on Tesla's locator.

Desert Center's 10-mile search and Tonopah, Arizona's 10-mile search returned no public DC fast sites on October 14, 2026. Chiriaco Summit's search returned ChargePoint units that are still unverified.

The Palm Desert search, 6 miles around the town, was completed from the DOE California file on October 15, 2026. Those sites are listed on the Indio stop. Ones not opened on a network locator stay unverified.

arrival: Phoenix city charging, and Goodyear, are not in this guide. The last stop is Buckeye at Watson Road.
